scope: historical failures; raw host logs remain local

items.observed: Second visible Qt application exited after display connect returned -16; aggregate correctly remained partial.
items.subsequent_action: Use an explicitly hidden session; no QPA or kernel changes.

items.observed: A real edit reached the unsaved-change guard; the first harness did not choose Discard and the Notes child was eventually cancelled.
items.subsequent_action: Use the real PS/2 discard control; rerun exited both children normally.

items.observed: Browser-denied guest behavior was observed, but its independent check failed because hidden Notes exited before its delayed owner digest.
items.subsequent_action: Emit the synthetic owner digest immediately only in a hidden test session; retain the original single delayed digest in visible tests.

items.observed: Earlier single-source runs recorded intermittent exit timeouts; the root cause was not conclusively established.
items.subsequent_action: The Notes branch uses a joinable native watchdog worker; the result remains scoped and does not prove the race eliminated.

items.observed: Static review found the previous two-sample path did not recheck Browser liveness after the Notes transaction; the old 48-run stress was deliberately interrupted after 10 completed passing sessions. No runtime failure was claimed for those ten.
items.subsequent_action: Share a final liveness recheck between ordinary sampling and a real-guest test in which Browser exits during Notes reading; the targeted test returns a partial aggregate.

interrupted_stress.reason: Stopped after code review found second-sample cross-source liveness was not rechecked; a corrected build requires a fresh stress run.

items.observed: An initial local fixture-copy command failed because a zsh special variable shadowed the executable search path before Git ran.
items.subsequent_action: The command was corrected to use a task-specific variable and the intended new fixture was populated; existing worktrees were not modified.

items.observed: The threaded Qt SDK receipt has no licenses section, so the first preparation failed. A second check against the reused system SDK failed because its components manifest differs from the current branch (24 versus 32 components).
items.subsequent_action: Preserved both attempts; a separate source-only notice/hash/SPDX check passed 175 registered checks and 43 changed files. Exact reused SDK-copy and archive-member license qualification remain unverified.

items.observed: Review found the earlier supervisor granted each text scope by default unless explicitly denied; this did not provide separately explicit opt-in at session start.
items.subsequent_action: Default both source text scopes to denied, require independent --browser-text and --notes-text opt-ins, and test default-denied as well as each separately granted scope on a new build.

interrupted_stress.reason: Stopped by operator after the initial authorization-default review; corrected build requires a fresh run.

items.reason: Portable build receipt verification required XOS_BUILD_DIR, but the initial regression wrapper did not require that variable. No guest was started and no boundary result was produced.
items.resolution: The wrapper now requires the SDK, Qt build and Qt source paths before starting. The unchanged 13-check guest probe was rerun in a new directory and passed 13/13 with resources restored.

items.observed: The public path scanner was initially given a directory as one input; it returned NOT_PUBLIC_READY with unreadable_file and scanned zero files.
items.subsequent_action: Invoke the scanner on each JSON file instead; all selected files were scanned successfully. The final staged-index and PR-body scans are separate.
